title: Pentagon says only three UAP videos exist, then another branch admits more
summary: Michael Shellenberger tells of Pentagon says only three UAP videos exist, then another branch admits more, about an unknown time at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: after some of these videos were released uh the Pentagon said yeah there's no more videos just those three videos

plain: A journalist, Michael Shellenberger, says that after some military videos of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, were made public, the Pentagon, headquarters of the US military, said there were no others beyond those three. Citing a records researcher named John Greenwald, he says another branch of the military later admitted it had more. If true, it would mean the Pentagon's public account of what it holds was incomplete.
